disposition_reason: Table 3 prints per-product mean lead, chromium, zinc, nickel, manganese, copper and iron in 11 cow milks (6 long-life full, 2 long-life skimmed, 2 pasteurized, 1 raw) from Misurata supermarkets; cobalt and cadmium not detected.

study.design: Retail survey of commercial cow milk (long-life full, long-life skimmed, pasteurized) plus one raw local milk
study.method: 3.0 g milk, HNO3 + H2O2 microwave digestion (MARS6); MP-AES 4100 (Agilent)
study.lod_text: not printed; Co and Cd below instrumental detection limits
study.qa: Reagent blanks; no CRM or recovery reported
